ChatGPT can now connect to iCloud Mail and Calendar. Every plan, on web, desktop and iOS.

Turns out the AI feature people keep asking for is simple: please just look at my inbox.

If you're on Microsoft 365, Copilot already sits on top of Outlook. Access isn't the problem anymore. The prompts are.

Stop at 'summarize this thread'? Try this one:

'What did I promise people this week that I haven't done yet?'
hits.video_tip: 20s screen record: Copilot in Outlook, paste the 'what did I promise' prompt, scroll the answer and highlight two real follow-ups. Caption: 'Your inbox already has a to-do list. Ask for it.'

hits.hook: Copilot Fusion Max within two points of Opus 5.5 Max at about half the cost
hits.text:
Frontier performance at a fraction of the cost. 

In the @ArtificialAnlys Coding Agent Index, Copilot Fusion Max scored within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max at about half the API cost per task.

Get 30% off through Nov. 30. Try it now. ⬇️  https://t.co/c0k5alLKqD https://t.co/kVBzvq8ph5
hits.original:
Frontier performance at a fraction of the cost. 

In the @ArtificialAnlys Coding Agent Index, Copilot Fusion Max scored within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max at about half the API cost per task.

Get 30% off through Nov. 30. Try it now. ⬇️  https://t.co/c0k5alLKqD https://t.co/kVBzvq8ph5
hits.draft_en:
Yesterday I said picking a model had become a dropdown.

Today GitHub removed the dropdown. Copilot Fusion routes each task across Anthropic and OpenAI models for you.

On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Fusion Max landed within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max, at about half the cost per task.

Same rule applies though. A router is only as smart as your evals. Decide what 'good' looks like on your repo before you let anything choose for you.
hits.video_tip: Vertical 25s: VS Code model picker, select Copilot Fusion, run one real task, then flash a tiny eval sheet with pass/fail ticks. Overlay: 'Let it choose. Then check its homework.'

hits.draft_en:
Connect the dots from this week:

PPCC: Copilot Studio gets a new harness, the GitHub Copilot harness under the hood.
Universe: the unified Copilot harness is now in Foundry too.

So makers in Copilot Studio and pro devs in Foundry are building agents on the same engine.

Low code isn't dead. It just got the pro dev engine.
hits.video_tip: Talking head 30s with a simple 3-box diagram (GitHub, Foundry, Copilot Studio) all pointing to one 'Copilot harness' box. End card: 'Same engine. Different steering wheel.'

drafts.text:
ChatGPT can now connect to iCloud Mail and Calendar. Every plan, on web, desktop and iOS.

Turns out the AI feature people keep asking for is simple: please just look at my inbox.

If you're on Microsoft 365, Copilot already sits on top of Outlook. Access isn't the problem anymore. The prompts are.

Stop at 'summarize this thread'? Try this one:

'What did I promise people this week that I haven't done yet?'
drafts.video_tip: 20s screen record: Copilot in Outlook, paste the 'what did I promise' prompt, scroll the answer and highlight two real follow-ups. Caption: 'Your inbox already has a to-do list. Ask for it.'

drafts.text:
Yesterday I said picking a model had become a dropdown.

Today GitHub removed the dropdown. Copilot Fusion routes each task across Anthropic and OpenAI models for you.

On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Fusion Max landed within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max, at about half the cost per task.

Same rule applies though. A router is only as smart as your evals. Decide what 'good' looks like on your repo before you let anything choose for you.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 25s: VS Code model picker, select Copilot Fusion, run one real task, then flash a tiny eval sheet with pass/fail ticks. Overlay: 'Let it choose. Then check its homework.'

drafts.text:
Connect the dots from this week:

PPCC: Copilot Studio gets a new harness, the GitHub Copilot harness under the hood.
Universe: the unified Copilot harness is now in Foundry too.

So makers in Copilot Studio and pro devs in Foundry are building agents on the same engine.

Low code isn't dead. It just got the pro dev engine.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head 30s with a simple 3-box diagram (GitHub, Foundry, Copilot Studio) all pointing to one 'Copilot harness' box. End card: 'Same engine. Different steering wheel.'

drafts.text:
Simon Willison says October is another inflection point for coding agents. Claude Opus 5.5 can build video games that are actually fun.

My October inflection point: a Power Automate expression that worked.

I closed the tab very slowly.

We all have our frontiers.
drafts.video_tip: Meme, 10s: left half a clip of an AI-built game, right half a Power Automate run turning green, then a hand slowly closing the laptop. Record-scratch sound, no voiceover.
